d:
Relive the magic of the timeless Bollywood classic "Hanste Hanste Kat Jaye Raste" from the iconic movie Khoon Bhari Maang. Featuring the legendary on-screen chemistry of Rekha and Rakesh Roshan, this evergreen melody continues to captivate audiences across generations.
Film cast: Kabir Bedi, Rekha, Shatrughan Sinha, Sonu Walia, Kader Khan, Rakesh Roshan, Saeed Jaffrey, Shobha Khote, A K Hangal, Sulochana, Tom Alter, Sulbha Deshpande, Satyajit Puri, Jairaj, Vikas Anand, Mangal Dhillon
Singer: Asha Bhosle, Sadhna Sargam, Nitin Mukesh, Sonali Bhatawdekar
Lyricist: Indeevar
